title: Ceramic dish came chipped and is "fake" grounded
text:
Ceramic dish came chipped and is "fake" grounded. Overall, this wall warmer works well. It gets warm enough to give a nice throw in my bathroom. It looks very pretty too. But I had to deducted two stars. First, the ceramic dish that holds the melted wax came chipped in two places. Had I used my hard earned cash to make this purchase, I would have been disappointed. Second, I deducted another star because the electric plug in is not technically grounded. It has the traditional American two prongs on top, and that fits into my wall plug fine. But the third prong (the bottom one of the triangle), is a plastic rod. Since plastic does NOT conduct electricity, it defeats the purpose of why this became a standard plug in feature here decades ago.
Hope this review was helpful.
